content: Hi how can i assist you today
My smartwatch buzzes exactly when I think of a person. It’s too aligned.
Haptics often signal app notifications or movement goals. Do the buzz times match messages, calendar alerts, or heart-rate prompts?
Some were message pings, some were stand reminders.
Those map to scheduled or event-driven alerts. Comparing buzzes on a notification-free hour to a normal hour can show how much alignment remains without signals.
I can set Do Not Disturb for an hour.
That creates a control window. Any residual buzzes would likely be fitness or system prompts.
A short list with labels—message, fitness, system—keeps it readable later.
